column1: # token.tsv: beam token replace (token) and append (token+) sequences from an empty NVS, except: append_to_preloaded starts with beam_token (str) = "abc", and append_to_preloaded_oversize_stored_ignored starts with beam_token (str) = 256 times "t". Columns: scenario, step, then as setters.tsv (op, setter, input, return, listener, nvs_writes, nvs_commits, nvs_entry, getters). A refused call (ESP_ERR_INVALID_SIZE) fires no listener, writes nothing and leaves the token as it was.
